test_case_summary: Manual test cases covering functional, negative, boundary, integration, security, reliability, and auditability scenarios for the On-Demand Mobility Application Payments Module, aligned with BRD requirements and risk-based test strategy.

test_cases.title: Display supported payment methods to rider
test_cases.objective: Verify that all configured payment methods are displayed to the rider on the payment selection screen
preconditions: Payment methods are configured in the system (DEP-002)
Rider is on the payment selection screen after ride completion
test_data: Configured payment methods: UPI, Credit/Debit Card, Wallet
steps: Navigate to the payment selection screen.
Verify UI elements for each payment method are present.
Confirm each method shows appropriate branding and masked details if previously saved.
expected_results: All supported payment methods are visible and selectable.
Each method displays appropriate branding and masked details if saved.

test_cases.title: Successful UPI payment with valid credentials
test_cases.objective: Process a valid UPI payment end-to-end and verify successful status after gateway confirmation
preconditions: Valid UPI credentials configured for test account (DEP-003)
Ride completed with final fare calculated (DEP-004)
Rider selects UPI as payment method
steps: Observe payment status transitions: Initiated -> Pending -> Successful.
expected_results: Payment initiates, gateway returns success confirmation.
Status transitions from Initiated -> Pending -> Successful.
Charged amount matches approved final fare (BR-005).

test_cases.title: UPI payment rejected due to invalid credentials
test_cases.objective: Attempt UPI payment with invalid UPI ID/VPA and verify appropriate failure handling
preconditions: Ride completed with final fare calculated
expected_results: Payment fails with clear error message (FR-PAY-008).

test_cases.title: Successful credit/debit card payment with valid card
test_cases.objective: Process a valid card payment and verify successful status after gateway confirmation
preconditions: Ride completed with final fare calculated (DEP-004)
Rider selects card payment and enters valid details
expected_results: Payment initiates, gateway returns success confirmation.
Sensitive card data masked in UI and logs (BR-007, NFR-003).
Charged amount matches approved final fare (BR-005).

test_cases.title: Card payment rejected due to expired card
test_cases.objective: Attempt card payment with expired card and verify failure handling
preconditions: Ride completed with final fare calculated
steps: Enter card details with expired date.
expected_results: Sensitive data not exposed in error messages.

test_cases.title: Successful wallet payment with sufficient balance
test_cases.objective: Process wallet payment when balance covers the fare and verify processing
preconditions: Wallet balance available and sufficient for fare (DEP-002)
Ride completed with final fare calculated (DEP-004)
Rider selects wallet as payment method
expected_results: Charged amount matches approved final fare (BR-005).

test_cases.title: Wallet payment blocked when balance insufficient
test_cases.objective: Attempt wallet payment with insufficient balance and verify appropriate handling
preconditions: Wallet balance available but less than fare amount
Ride completed with final fare calculated (DEP-004)
Rider selects wallet as payment method
steps: Verify prompt to add funds or choose alternative payment.
expected_results: Payment fails with clear 'Insufficient funds' error (ERR-002, FR-PAY-008).
Rider prompted to add funds or choose alternative payment method.

test_cases.title: Display final ride fare with discounts before payment confirmation
test_cases.objective: Verify final fare including applicable discounts/adjustments is displayed before rider confirms payment
steps: Verify fare breakdown displayed: base fare, discount, adjustment, total.
Confirm displayed total matches amount sent to payment gateway.
expected_results: Final fare displayed with breakdown (base fare, discounts, adjustments, total).
Displayed total matches amount sent to payment gateway (BR-005, FR-PAY-018).

test_cases.title: Payment marked successful only after gateway confirmation
test_cases.objective: Verify payment status transitions to Successful only upon receiving explicit gateway success confirmation
preconditions: Payment initiated and in Pending state (PS-002)
expected_results: Status updates from Pending to Successful (PS-003) only after gateway confirmation received.

test_cases.title: Payment remains pending when gateway confirmation delayed
test_cases.objective: Verify payment stays in Pending state when gateway response is delayed, and reconciles correctly when response arrives
preconditions: Gateway response delayed beyond normal timeout
steps: Observe status Pending with processing indicator.
Verify reconciliation occurs (BR-008) and status updates to Successful or Failed accordingly.
expected_results: Status remains Pending (PS-002) with processing indicator.
When delayed response arrives, reconciliation occurs (BR-008) and status updates to Successful or Failed based on actual gateway outcome.

test_cases.title: Display correct payment status for each state
test_cases.objective: Verify UI accurately reflects Initiated, Pending, Successful, Failed, Refund Initiated, and Refunded statuses
preconditions: Payment status model defined (PS-001 to PS-006)
Test transactions in each status state available
test_data: Sample transaction IDs per status: Initiated: TXN-INIT, Pending: TXN-PEND, Successful: TXN-SUCC, Failed: TXN-FAIL, Refund Initiated: TXN-REFI, Refunded: TXN-REFUND
steps: For each status, navigate to transaction details screen.
Verify UI label, icon, and actionable options match status.
Ensure Failed payments never shown as Successful.
expected_results: Each status displays appropriate label, icon, and actionable options (e.g., retry for Failed, view receipt for Successful, track refund for Refund Initiated).
Failed payments never shown as Successful (BR-004).

test_cases.title: Show clear error message for gateway rejection
test_cases.objective: Verify user-friendly error message displayed when payment gateway rejects transaction
test_data: Expected user-friendly message: 'Payment declined. Please try another method.'
steps: Verify no raw gateway codes exposed.
expected_results: Clear, non‑technical error message shown (e.g., 'Payment declined. Please try another method.').
No sensitive gateway error codes exposed to user.

test_cases.title: Eligible payment retry after failure without duplicate charge
test_cases.objective: Verify rider can retry failed payment and only single charge occurs
preconditions: Unique transaction reference generated per attempt (BR-002)
steps: Perform a payment that fails (e.g., invalid card).
Enter valid payment details (e.g., correct card).
Verify only one charge applied (new transaction).
expected_results: Retry initiates new payment attempt with new transaction reference.
Only successful retry results in charge.

test_cases.title: Prevent duplicate charging on rapid repeated submissions
test_cases.objective: Verify idempotency when rider taps pay button multiple times rapidly
preconditions: Payment initiated, gateway request in progress
Rider taps pay button multiple times within short interval
test_data: Simulated rapid taps: 3 taps within 1 second
steps: Verify only one request sent to gateway (monitor network logs).
Verify final status reflects single transaction.
expected_results: Only single payment request sent to gateway.
Status updates correctly based on single gateway response.

test_cases.title: Handle network interruption during payment processing
test_cases.objective: Verify payment state remains consistent when network fails mid-transaction
preconditions: Payment initiated, request sent to gateway
Network connectivity lost before response received
steps: Verify payment state preserved locally (status Pending).
Verify automatic reconciliation (BR-008) and status update to actual outcome.
expected_results: App detects network loss, shows offline indicator.
On network restore, app reconciles with gateway (BR-008) and updates status to actual outcome.
No data loss or inconsistent state (NFR-006).

test_cases.title: Handle payment gateway timeout
test_cases.objective: Verify graceful handling when payment gateway does not respond within timeout threshold
preconditions: Gateway request sent, no response within configured timeout
steps: Observe UI message: "Payment processing taking longer than expected. We are checking with your bank."
Verify status remains Pending with timeout indicator.
Verify transaction preserved for later retry.
expected_results: User sees processing message with 'Wait' and 'Retry Later' options.
Status remains Pending (PS-002) with timeout indication.

test_cases.title: Initiate eligible refund for qualifying transaction
test_cases.objective: Verify refund can be initiated for transaction meeting business policy criteria
preconditions: Transaction meets eligibility criteria per BR-006
Rider or support initiates refund request
test_data: Refund policy: Full refund within 30 mins
steps: Verify status changes to Refund Initiated (PS-005).
After processing, verify status updates to Refunded (PS-006).
expected_results: Refund initiated, status transitions to Refund Initiated (PS-005).

test_cases.title: Reject refund initiation for ineligible transaction
test_cases.objective: Verify refund cannot be initiated for transaction not meeting policy criteria
preconditions: Transaction does not meet eligibility criteria (e.g., outside time window, non-refundable fare type)
test_data: Refund policy: Refund only within 15 minutes
steps: Verify error message: "Refund not eligible per policy (e.g., outside time window)."
expected_results: Refund initiation blocked with clear reason (e.g., 'Refund not eligible per policy').

test_cases.title: Display refund status progression to rider
test_cases.objective: Verify rider sees accurate refund status updates from initiation to completion
preconditions: Refund initiated for transaction (status Refund Initiated - PS-005)
Rider views transaction details or refund tracking screen
steps: Verify status displayed as 'Refund Initiated' with timeline.
Verify status updates to 'Refunded' (PS-006) with reference and amount.
expected_results: Refund status displayed as 'Refund Initiated' with estimated timeline.
On completion, status updates to 'Refunded' (PS-006) with refund reference and amount.

test_cases.title: Display complete transaction history with required details
test_cases.objective: Verify transaction history shows all required data elements for each transaction
test_data: TXN-001: Ride ID R001, Date 2023-10-01 10:00, Method UPI, Amount $12.00, Status Successful
TXN-002: Ride ID R002, Date 2023-10-02 11:30, Method Card, Amount $15.00, Status Failed
TXN-003: Ride ID R003, Date 2023-10-03 12:45, Method Wallet, Amount $9.00, Status Refunded
steps: For each transaction, verify presence of Ride ID, Transaction ID, Date/Time, Payment Method, Fare Amount, Discounts/Adjustments, Payment Status, Gateway Reference, Refund Status (if applicable).
Verify sensitive data masked (e.g., card number shown as ****1111).
expected_results: History lists transactions with: Ride ID, Transaction ID, Date/Time, Payment Method, Fare Amount, Discounts/Adjustments, Payment Status, Gateway Reference, Refund Status (if applicable).

test_cases.title: Generate payment receipt with required details after success
test_cases.objective: Verify receipt/confirmation provided with all necessary information after successful payment
preconditions: Rider views receipt screen or receives digital receipt
steps: After successful payment, navigate to Receipt screen (or view notification).
Verify receipt contains Transaction ID, Ride ID, Date/Time, Payment Method (masked if needed), Fare Amount, Discounts/Adjustments, Total Charged, Gateway Reference, Status: Successful.
expected_results: Receipt shows: Transaction ID, Ride ID, Date/Time, Payment Method (masked), Fare Amount, Discounts/Adjustments, Total Charged, Gateway Reference, Status: Successful.

test_cases.title: Send notification for payment success, failure, and refund events
test_cases.objective: Verify notifications delivered for key payment lifecycle events
preconditions: Payment events occur (success, failure, refund initiated, refund completed)
steps: Trigger each payment event (via test harness).
Verify push notification or in-app alert appears for each event.
Verify notification content includes relevant details (transaction ID, amount, status).
Verify notifications are delivered within acceptable time (<5 mins).
expected_results: Timely push/in-app notifications sent for: Payment Successful (with amount), Payment Failed (with retry prompt), Refund Initiated, Refund Completed.

test_cases.title: Charge approved final fare including discounts and adjustments
test_cases.objective: Verify charged amount exactly matches approved final fare with all adjustments applied
preconditions: Ride completed with base fare, applicable discounts, and adjustments calculated
steps: On payment screen, review fare breakdown.
Verify amount sent to gateway equals $27.00.
Verify gateway charges exactly this amount.
expected_results: Amount sent to gateway equals approved final fare (base - discounts + adjustments).
Receipt and history reflect same amount.

test_cases.title: Require authentication for sensitive payment actions
test_cases.objective: Verify authentication challenge presented for sensitive payment operations
preconditions: Rider attempts sensitive payment action (e.g., adding new card, changing default payment, initiating refund)
Session valid but requires step-up authentication
steps: While logged in, navigate to "Payment Settings" -> "Add New Card".
Verify sensitive card data never displayed unmasked (e.g., full card number shown as ****).
expected_results: Action only proceeds on successful authentication.
Sensitive payment data never displayed unmasked per BR-007, NFR-003.

test_cases.title: Maintain transaction identifiers and audit trail for support
test_cases.objective: Verify all required identifiers and timestamps persisted for audit and support investigation
steps: Verify system logs contain all required fields: Ride ID, Transaction ID, Rider ID, Payment Method, Fare Amount, Discounts/Adjustments, Timestamps (initiation, gateway request, gateway response, final status), Gateway Reference, Payment Status, Refund Reference/Status (if applicable).
Verify sensitive data masked in logs (e.g., card number masked).
Access audit log via support console.
Verify entries are searchable and retain required data without exposing sensitive information.
expected_results: System retains: Ride ID, Transaction ID, Rider ID, Payment Method, Fare Amount, Discounts/Adjustments, Timestamps (initiation, gateway request, gateway response, final status), Gateway Reference, Payment Status, Refund Reference/Status (if applicable).
Sensitive data masked in logs (BR-007, NFR-007).

test_cases.title: Handle invalid UPI/payment credentials error
test_cases.objective: Verify specific handling for invalid credential format or unregistered UPI ID
preconditions: Rider enters malformed UPI ID or unregistered VPA
steps: Verify client-side error message: "Invalid UPI format. Please enter a valid VPA."
Verify no request sent to gateway.
Verify status remains Initiated (or no transaction).
expected_results: Immediate client-side validation error for format issues.
For unregistered VPA, gateway rejection handled with clear message 'Invalid UPI ID. Please verify and try again.'

test_cases.title: Handle gateway rejection with specific decline reason
test_cases.objective: Verify appropriate user messaging for different gateway rejection codes
preconditions: Payment gateway returns specific rejection codes
test_data: Expected user message: "Insufficient funds. Please use another payment method."
steps: Verify UI displays user-friendly message: "Insufficient funds. Please use another payment method."
Verify raw gateway code not exposed.
expected_results: Generic rejection mapped to user-friendly messages: 'Insufficient funds' (ERR-002), 'Card blocked - contact bank', 'Transaction limit exceeded'.

test_cases.title: Handle gateway timeout with retry option
test_cases.objective: Verify timeout handling provides clear user guidance and preserves transaction integrity
preconditions: Gateway request sent, no response within timeout threshold
steps: Observe UI message: "Payment processing taking longer than expected. We are checking with your bank."
Verify status remains Pending with timeout indicator.
Verify transaction preserved for later retry.
expected_results: User sees processing message with 'Wait' and 'Retry Later' options.
Status remains Pending (PS-002) with timeout indication.

test_cases.title: Handle network interruption with offline indicator
test_cases.objective: Verify app behavior when network lost during payment flow
steps: Verify payment state preserved locally (status Pending).
Verify automatic reconciliation (BR-008) and status update to Successful/Failed.
expected_results: No data loss or inconsistent state (NFR-006).

test_cases.title: Handle app closed during payment processing
test_cases.objective: Verify payment state recovery when app is killed/closed mid-transaction
preconditions: App force-closed or crashed by user/system
steps: On app restart, verify payment status fetched from backend.
expected_results: On app restart, payment status fetched from backend.

test_cases.title: Handle repeated submission without duplicate charge
test_cases.objective: Verify idempotency protection against repeated payment submissions
preconditions: Multiple identical payment requests submitted rapidly (simulated)
steps: Verify only one request sent to gateway (monitor network).
Verify final status reflects single transaction.
expected_results: Subsequent requests return 'Payment already in progress' or are deduplicated at gateway.

test_cases.title: Handle delayed payment status response
test_cases.objective: Verify polling/reconciliation handles delayed gateway status updates correctly
preconditions: Gateway status update delayed (async callback or polling)
test_data: Simulated delay of 2 minutes before gateway callback
steps: When gateway response arrives, status updates to Successful/Failed.
expected_results: Status updates to final state (Successful/Failed) when authoritative response received.
